question: Given any five points in the square $I^2=\{(x,y):0\le x\le1,\ 0\le y\le1\}$, only one of the following statements is true. Which one is it?

options.A: The five points lie on a circle.
options.B: At least one square can be formed using four of the five points.
options.C: At least three of the five points are collinear.
options.D: There are at least two points such that the distance between them does not exceed $\frac1{\sqrt2}$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
